entities.summary: Magnus Hellberg is a Swedish professional ice hockey goaltender for Djurgårdens IF of the Swedish Hockey League (SHL). He has previously played in the National Hockey League (NHL) with the Nashville Predators, New York Rangers, Ottawa Senators, Detroit Red Wings, and Pittsburgh Penguins.
